about: Measured render facts quoted in the manuscript. scripts/03_manuscript_numbers.py reads this file when no render log is on disk, rewrites the 'v2' entry whenever a complete log is present, and rewrites 'v2.frame_mtimes' and 'day0_frame_v1' with --measure-frames. The frames themselves are git-ignored (blender/exports/).

v1.source: Written by scripts/03_manuscript_numbers.py from the last FRAME_DONE line of /tmp/growth_animation_render.log; committed in generated_numbers.tex at 569a186 (2026-09-19). The log itself was not kept.

v2.source: Written by scripts/03_manuscript_numbers.py from the last FRAME_DONE line of /tmp/growth_animation_v2_render.log; committed in generated_numbers.tex at 3a898aa (2026-09-21). The log itself was not kept.

frame_mtimes.note: Independent check of the logged figures: file modification times of frame_0000 to frame_0575.

day0_frame_v1.method: Pixels with mean RGB above 110 inside x 700-1300, y 200-700 (soil background is about 50-75, the seedling about 150-200); bounding box of those pixels as a share of the full frame.
